zb eval --expression 'toFile("ref.txt", path("hello.txt"))'
stdout ^$ZB_STORE_DIR${/}

read storePath
zb store object info --dot --output=graph.dot $storePath
grep 'ref\.txt.*->.*hello\.txt' graph.dot

# Check Graphviz syntax.
? cat graph.dot
[exec:nop] exec nop -p graph.dot

-- hello.txt --
Hello, World!
